title: content/stats.yaml — stat registry (D7/D10)
description: Data-driven stat definitions loaded by platform/config into the engine/stats Registry. Adding a stat is a data edit, not a code edit (D10). Identifiers must match the canonical names in docs/core/glossary.md (no schema enum, so adding a stat needs no schema change; platform/config cross-checks references against this file).

identifier.description: Canonical StatID (docs/core/glossary.md). Must start with a letter.

label.description: Human-readable display name for UI / why-trace ONLY. Optional. NOT read by engine or platform logic today (engine/stats carries it through and ignores it); falls back to id when absent. Purely cosmetic, non-load-bearing metadata — safe to omit.

kind.description: capability (Strength/Agility/Intelligence — read by gates/outcomes/prediction) or disposition (value-weighting axes). Stats themselves are freely addable (id is unconstrained, pure data); a NEW kind, however, carries engine semantics, so adding one is a deliberate schema+engine extension, not pure data (design.md D7).

range.description: [min, max] inclusive clamp for Real Stats and ToM beliefs. min <= max (cross-field, enforced by platform/config / engine.stats.Load, beyond JSON Schema).

gen.description: Agent-GENERATION distribution: how a fresh agent's value for this stat is sampled at spawn, with the injected seeded RNG (D12). This is the PRIMARY source of initial values and takes PRECEDENCE over 'default' — 'default' is never used for sampling. Required in the shipped content.

default.description: FALLBACK / baseline value used ONLY when 'gen' is absent or when a vector is built without sampling (Registry.Defaults(): zero-config, reset, or a missing key). When 'gen' is present it WINS for initial assignment and 'default' is ignored for sampling. Optional; defaults to the range midpoint (min+max)/2. Must lie within range — platform/config / engine.stats.Load enforces min <= default <= max (cross-field, beyond JSON Schema).

inherit.description: Parent-inheritance weight; (1 - inherit) is fresh perturbation.
